summary: John's 5th great-grandfather; citizen and carpenter (Zimmermann) of Munzingen — the furthest the Meier line goes in any record found.
bio: Michael Mayer was a citizen (Bürger) and carpenter of Munzingen, named in his son Heinrich's 1820 marriage. His wife is not named there and his dates are not found. FamilySearch lists him as a bare name (PW7H-2P6). If he died 1810–39 his death is in the L 10 Nr. 1590 'Todtfälle' sections (not fully scanned). Four generations of the family worked in building trades: Michael carpenter, Heinrich mason, Friedrich stone mason, Henry iron moulder.
